products.sovkora: the AI engine our products run on, on the operator's own infrastructure; it holds no certification
products.verikora: the papers of a rental file read and checked: leases against the law in force on their date, every finding quoted, every run traced
products.folioviv: bookings, bilingual invoices with GST/QST and a tax ledger for independent Québec shops; it prepares the GST/QST return, the merchant reviews and files it; not for restaurants and bars

stack.ui: the design system of every Krizaka site and product: web and native components, tokens, icons, page blocks and templates (its own index: https://ui.krizaka.com/llms.txt)
stack.motion: the motion lab: experimental visuals played on its own site, not a package
stack.java: the Spring Boot building blocks (BOM, parent, starters, messaging, users, notifications, billing), published on Maven Central under com.krizaka
stack.ts: the TypeScript building blocks of the products' back ends, on npm, one page per package
